lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Don't forget to do your homework.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Students whose names I call, please report to the teachers' office.
The four of them are called to the teachers' office.
I trail after them to the teachers' office.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Then, everyone is okay with today's schedule, right?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll wait in front of the main gate after school.
It seems I'm too late, as they're already coming out of the teachers' office.
But who'd tell me if I asked...?
I approach Arcana, who is smiling cheerfully, and ask her.
So, what were you talking about with Miss Privaty just now?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A teacher's dedication to her students? Or maybe it was a counseling session?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway, you don't have any plans after school today, do you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Even if you do, cancel them.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: In times like this, just wait patiently and pretend like you don't know anything.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh! The bell's about to ring.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Shall we get back to class?
I ask Ein, who is openly staring at me.
So, what were you talking about with Miss Privaty just now?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: By the way, you don't have anything planned after school today, do you?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Honestly, I don't think you do.
What are you even talking about—

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: If you play with us after school, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Make sure to leave some time in your schedule.
I sneakily approach Zwei and ask.
So, what were you talking about with Miss Privaty just now?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Miss Privaty said not to tell.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: By the way, are you free after school, Teacher?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We should get back. Class is about to start.
I sneakily approach Rei and ask.
So, what were you talking about with Miss Privaty just now?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Oh, she asked us what we usually do for fun.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Apparently, Miss Privaty, the four of us, and you are all going to hang out after school.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What was it she said again...? Something about school memories?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Miss Privaty said to keep it a secret!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Then it's a secret! I'm not saying a word!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'm pretty sure you've already said it all.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Just pretend you didn't hear anything and come out with us after school.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wouldn't it be fun if we all hung out together?
Before long, the school day comes to an end.
We gather in front of the school gate.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahem! The reason I called you all here today

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: is to conduct a little investigation

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: into where you usually hang out after school.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: But earlier you clearly said— Mmmph!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I believe I said the same thing earlier, Rei.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: At a time like this, we should be eating something delicious.
You're awfully excited for an investigation.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I can't exactly go around looking intimidating, can I?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm not here to interfere, I merely came to observe.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Yeah, since we're students, our budget is kinda tight.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Hamburgers are a go-to for students!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: It's also convenient because we can eat quickly.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's grab a seat and order quickly.
and it's ready in no time, true to fast-food fashion.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: We have to pour out the fries.
Rei, Ein, and Zwei pour the fries out into the center of the table with practiced ease.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Food tastes better when it's shared, don't you think?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Also, it's easier to eat this way.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Arcana, Teacher, Miss Privaty, you should pour yours out too.
I reach out and dump my fries onto the pile too.
Privaty, why are you sitting so far away?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's fine. My arm is long enough to reach.
It clearly sounds like she's showing off.
The six of us are seated at the largest table in the burger joint.
Rei, sitting at the opposite end, attempts to pour her fries toward the center.
Unfortunately, her limited reach causes her fries to be piled up to the side instead.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Rei, Zwei, can I try some of your burger?
I haven't had this in a while. It's tasty.
As expected, Privaty ignores the fries, focusing solely on the burger in front of her.
I pick up a fry and offer it to Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I can reach them perfectly fine on my own.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... But since you're offering, thank you.
Privaty reaches for the fry I offer,
but I pop it straight into her mouth instead.
Her lips end up touching my fingertips.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes, it's perfectly salty and delicious!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But I have hands too! I can eat on my own just fine!
Privaty, blushing, stands up and starts scarfing down the fries.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Is this a speed-eating contest? No way I'm losing!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ahhh, that hit the spot. I'm stuffed.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Shall we head to the next place?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Miss Privaty, you weren't listening earlier, were you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I knew you looked kind of spaced out.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We're going to karaoke after we finish our burgers, remember?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Not that way, Miss Privaty. This way.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Y-you could have told me sooner!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: First one to sing gets bragging rights!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'll kick things off with "Penguin Revolution"!
Do you like karaoke, Miss Privaty?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I haven't gone too many times, so I don't really know.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm usually so busy with work.
Then why don't you sing something?
I hold out the remote to Privaty.
Rei is singing at the top of her lungs.
The others are screaming along with her.
I'll sing a song for you.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: That actually sounds like a good fit, but kind of unexpected.
A smooth backing track begins to play.

Blazing spotlight, our eyes meet,
our hearts beat, just follow my lead.

Shine till the end, hands up, let's fly,
don't stop tonight, we jump up high!
I go all out, singing and dancing like a superstar.
I glance at Privaty as I strike my finishing pose.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I didn't expect you to sing something like that...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So close to a perfect 100. That's a shame!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ooh! I think that'd be a perfect fit for your voice, Teacher.

The days without you feel endless,
the image of you turning away still lingers.

I love you, it's always been you,
I whisper those words into the night.
I sing each sorrowful lyric with intention.
As the song ends, I reach out to Privaty as if confessing my love for her.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wow! I thought my heart was going to burst.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: This song really tugs at the heartstrings.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You said it was a song for me?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... It was pretty cool, I guess.
What was that? I couldn't hear you.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good! I'm glad you didn't hear!
Suddenly, what looks like a coupon spits out of the machine.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I heard they give you a free hour if you get a perfect score.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I've never actually seen it happen, but I guess it's true.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Hip-hop? Did you say hip-hop, Teacher?

Yo. Lights off, I'm fallin' in the dark.
Promises are poison, sweet words end in erosion.

Right here, no place, no name, no way.
Don't reach out, don't come close, I move my way.
I wave my hands in the air as I rap passionately.
At the end, I swagger towards Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It certainly left an impression... in more ways than one.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Especially since you said it was a song for me.
I thought I sang well, but maybe it wasn't Privaty's style.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: A p-promise is a promise, I suppose.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I don't know many songs. I'm not sure if this one's on the machine...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: This is the only real song that I know.
I assume you learned it at the maid cafe?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes, it was chosen as this year's theme song.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The lyrics conveys the mindset of a maid very well.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Looks like this wasn't what you expected. Are you disappointed?
No, I was just wondering if it's really okay for me to hear you sing all by myself.
Unfortunately the others don't hear me.
Privaty's cute and lively song ends.
We have so much fun singing that before we know it, the sun has set.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: That was so much fun! Too bad it's over.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Dorm curfew's about to kick in.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyone up for a late-night snack when we get back?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I worked up an appetite with all that singing.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Looks like they've all grown pretty close.
So, did you find the results of your investigation satisfactory?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Investigation? What are you talking about?
Didn't you bring us together to investigate where students go outside of school?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Actually, that was just an excuse.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You said you didn't have any memories of your time at school.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I wanted to create some for you.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Nothing over the top. Just perfectly ordinary school memories.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I wanted to ask you the same question.
Privaty looks up at me with a slightly nervous expression.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I actually prepared one more thing.
As long as we can still get back before curfew, it should be fin—
Before I can finish my sentence,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: D-don't be so loud, everyone will turn around.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And we'll still make it back before curfew.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I just thought it'd be nice for you to have a moment like this while you're in school.
Also, you're the one who's being too loud.
Privaty bows her head down deeply.
I want to see your face.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You can look all you want during class!
We bicker as we walk back.
We hold hands the whole way, not letting go until we reach the dorms.
